name: NEXUS — University Innovation Centre
notes: Only assigned Level 2 is included; all twelve shared reservation rectangles and floor metadata are unchanged.
Furniture grids expand to 180 student chairs, six teacher desks and chairs, 24 electronics positions, 24 robotics positions, 20 workshop positions and 16 faculty workstations.
Classrooms occupy the west/south teaching wing. Robotics and fabrication occupy the east; three equipment stores buffer the workshop from north circulation. Maker access has a controlled doorway.
Rectangles fit the 54 × 36 m footprint without positive-area room overlaps. Furniture grids remain within their assigned spaces; the courtyard void remains empty.

Assume 4 m storey height and stated wall thicknesses. Core fixtures are indicative within preserved reservations; stair flights, lift shafts and accessible toilet partitioning require specialist detailing.
Classrooms 2 and 4 rely on a future borrowed-light strategy; no windows have been invented on internal room boundaries.

Workshop equipment footprints are allowances. Extraction, power, dust/noise isolation, controlled access hardware, structure, courtyard guarding and fire strategy remain unresolved. This is a conceptual proposal for review, with no construction approval or pricing claimed.
